{{Quote|As you must now know, your courier has failed to deliver these government documents. If you wish to get them back, you must bring me 1,000,000 credits. I await your response.|Preens B'oola|<ref name="SWG:WftG" />}}
'''Preens B'oola''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] criminal who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], B'oola was leading a group of thugs active around [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]].<ref name="SWG:WftG" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Preens B'oola assassinated a courier working for the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] government in a street of Coronet City. His objective was to steal the government documents that the courier was carrying for ransom. [[Gallura Handerin]], a government aide at the [[Coronet Capitol]], thus tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with finding the missing courier. The spacer eventually found the dead courier and a message from B'oola, asking for a huge ransom of 1,000,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The spacer, who was also working as a [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] agent for [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mack Jasper]], tracked Preens B'oola to his camp on the outskirts of Coronet City and finally killed him to recover the government documents.<ref name="SWG:WftG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Preens B'oola was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:WftG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Preens B'oola was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> He was part of questline that featured the Rogue CorSec plot against the Diktat.<ref name="SWG:WftG" /> This story arc was later slightly revamped with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 27 Notes for February 15th, 2006|Publish 27]]," on [[February 15]], [[2006]],<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref> as the questline was integrated into the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]," the main questline in the game.<ref name="SWG:WftG" />
